evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-01", a date with no time. A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2026-09-01"} returned 200 and dueDate "2026-09-01". PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 and dueDate null, so the date was changed and then removed.
evidence.AC3: POST /todos with dueDate "2026-02-30", "30-02-2026", "abc", "2026-10-23T10:00:00" and the number 5 each returned 400. PATCH with dueDate "2026-02-30" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-23 UTC. I created todos due 2026-10-01 (past), 2026-12-01 (future), 2026-10-23 (today), no due date, and 2026-10-01 marked done. GET /todos?overdueOnly=true returned only the past, not-done todo (id 1). The future, today, no-due-date and done todos were excluded.
evidence.AC5: The list page at / showed a time element with the due date for each todo that has one: 2026-10-01, 2026-12-01, 2026-10-23, and 2026-10-01 for the done todo. The todo with no due date showed none.
evidence.AC6: On the list page only the 'past' todo (due 2026-10-01, not done) had the word 'überfällig'. The future, today, no-due-date and done-past todos had no marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled 'nur überfällige'. After I clicked it, the list showed only the 'past' todo with the überfällig marker.
